title: WCL Mining Sirdar Mock Test 10
subtitle: Western Coalfields Limited — Mining Sirdar Recruitment
instructions: Select the best answer for each question

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Stone dust is used in coal mines to
options: Prevent propagation of coal dust explosion
questions.solution: Stone dust prevents propagation of coal dust explosions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'post-incident debriefing' for a rescue team is important because
options: It helps identify lessons learned and improve future response
questions.solution: Helps identify lessons learned and improve future response.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'communication' between the driver and the boarding point must be
options: Only at the start of the shift
questions.solution: Continuous and reliable.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The operator of a man riding system must know
options: Emergency procedures, signaling, and vehicle condition
questions.solution: Emergency procedures, signaling, and vehicle condition.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'charging and blasting' in drifting must be supervised by
options: A competent shot firer or blaster
questions.solution: A competent shot firer or blaster.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'supported roof' in underground mines requires
options: Adequate support based on geological conditions
questions.solution: Roof support depends on geological conditions and mining method.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, the sirdar shall
options: Obey lawful instructions and report unsafe conditions
Defer all matters to the workmen's inspector
questions.solution: The sirdar must obey lawful instructions and report unsafe conditions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Dry stowing involves
options: Placing waste material without using water
questions.solution: Placing waste material without using water.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'emergency dewatering' arrangement must be
options: Available only in the rainy season
Available and tested at regular intervals
questions.solution: Available and tested at regular intervals.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'edge protection' at dump faces must include
questions.solution: Dump face protection requires berms, barriers, signs.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'register of persons employed' in a mine must contain
options: Name, age, nature of work, and other prescribed particulars
Only the wages of the persons
The names of the officials only
The list of visitors to the mine
questions.solution: Name, age, nature of work, and other prescribed particulars.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'cost of stowing' depends on
options: Material type, transportation distance, and equipment used
questions.solution: Material type, transportation distance, and equipment.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The minimum quantity of stone dust required per 100 meters of roadway depends on
options: The cross-sectional area and type of rock dust
questions.solution: Cross-sectional area and type of rock dust determine quantity.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'coal face' in underground mining is where
questions.solution: Coal face is the active extraction area.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'borehole sealing' near water bodies is done to
options: Prevent uncontrolled water inflow into workings
questions.solution: Borehole sealing prevents uncontrolled water inflow.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'bench drainage' system must prevent
questions.solution: Bench drainage prevents water accumulation and instability.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'effective digging radius' determines
options: Horizontal area within which machine can work
questions.solution: Effective digging radius defines working horizontal range.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The braking system of a man riding system must be
options: Capable of stopping the fully loaded car within prescribed distance
questions.solution: Must be capable of stopping within prescribed distance.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rescue equipment storage' should be
questions.solution: Equipment must be stored in clean, dry, accessible location.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'gas explosion' in coal mines requires
questions.solution: Gas explosions require methane, oxygen, and ignition source.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'recommendations' in a report should be based on
options: Factual findings and analysis of the data collected
questions.solution: Factual findings and analysis of the data collected.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'follow-up report' tracks
options: The production statistics of the mine
Implementation status and effectiveness of previously recommended actions
questions.solution: Implementation status and effectiveness of actions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'truck fleet optimization' balances
options: Shovel-truck match, cycle times, production targets
questions.solution: Fleet optimization balances matching, cycle times, and targets.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'bench height' safety considerations include
questions.solution: Bench height must be safe for equipment and geology.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'gas detection alarm' must be set at
options: At the temperature of the strata
Below the permissible limits to give early warning
questions.solution: Below permissible limits for early warning.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Swiss cheese model' of accident causation was proposed by
questions.solution: James Reason proposed the Swiss cheese model.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Every mechanised outlet (shaft or incline) is examined at least once in every 7 days by:
options: An engineer, electrical supervisor or foreman, or a competent person authorised by the engineer
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 75(2): mechanised outlets are examined at least once in 7 days by an engineer, electrical supervisor or foreman (or authorised competent person), recorded in a bound paged book.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fire extinguisher' types suitable for coal mines include
options: Dry chemical, foam, and CO2 types
questions.solution: Coal mines use dry chemical, foam, and CO2 extinguishers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'mine rescue team' must be equipped with
options: Breathing apparatus, gas detectors, communication equipment, and first aid
questions.solution: Breathing apparatus, gas detectors, communication, and first aid.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A sump must have
options: Adequate capacity and proper drainage arrangements
questions.solution: Adequate capacity and proper drainage arrangements.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'ventilation survey' measures
options: Air quantity, quality, resistance, and distribution
questions.solution: Ventilation surveys measure quantity, quality, resistance, distribution.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The electrical cables used in underground coal mines must be
options: Flame-retardant and fire-resistant as per IS standards
questions.solution: Must be flame-retardant and fire-resistant.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Before each shift, the man riding system operator must
options: Carry out a test run before carrying passengers
questions.solution: A test run must be carried out before carrying passengers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fire fighting technique' for coal mine fires includes
options: Water, foam, inert gases, and isolation methods
questions.solution: Fire fighting uses water, foam, inert gases, isolation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'drift lighting' in underground mines must be
options: Adequate for safe operations and inspections
A single lamp at the drift mouth
Only battery torches of the miners
questions.solution: Drift lighting must be adequate for safe operations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Before a man riding system is used, it must be
options: Tested for load capacity and safety
questions.solution: The system must be tested for load capacity and safety.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar's report book must contain entries about
options: Safety conditions, persons employed, work done, and any contraventions
The personal opinions of the manager
The provisional drafts of the surveyor
The names of the workers on leave
questions.solution: Entries cover safety, persons, work done, and contraventions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The water gauge in a mine is used to measure
options: Water pressure or head in the mine
questions.solution: Measures water pressure or head in the mine.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A shaft used for winding persons must have
options: Proper landing arrangements at all levels
questions.solution: Proper landing arrangements at all levels are required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The minimum spacing of pull cord switches on a conveyor belt is
questions.solution: At 10-20 meter intervals.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'chock' in underground mining is used to
options: Support the roof with high load capacity
questions.solution: Chocks provide high-capacity roof support.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fire drill' frequency in mines should be
questions.solution: Fire drills should be conducted at least twice yearly.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An 'inert gas' used for fire suppression in mines includes
options: Nitrogen, CO2, or other inert gases
questions.solution: Nitrogen, CO2, or other inert gases.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'overbreak' in drifting refers to
questions.solution: Excavation beyond the planned perimeter.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'gas detection equipment' carried by a rescue team must be able to detect
options: Only the presence of water vapour
Methane, carbon monoxide, oxygen deficiency, and other hazardous gases
questions.solution: Methane, CO, oxygen deficiency, and other hazardous gases.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'safety lever' of a winding engine must be
options: Within easy reach of the operator at all times
questions.solution: Within easy reach of the operator at all times.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fire compartmentation' in mines involves
options: Dividing mine into sections to limit fire spread
Painting the roadways with fire-resistant paint
questions.solution: Compartmentation divides mine to limit fire spread.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'hydrogen sulphide' (H2S) in mines is characterized by
options: Rotten egg smell and highly toxic
questions.solution: H2S has rotten egg smell and is highly toxic.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: In gassy mines, electric lighting from a source external to the lighting unit may be used on any roadway or place:
options: Ventilated by intake air or not within 270 m of the nearest face
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 176(1): external-source electric lighting is permitted on intake-air roadways or places not within 270 m of the nearest face.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: As per CMR 2017, every plan and section at a mine shall be:
options: Serially numbered and stored flat, with indexed field books kept at the mine
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 68: plans and sections are serially numbered, stored flat, and field books indexed and kept at the mine office.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fill ratio' in stowing must be
options: The ratio of water to sand
As high as possible to maximize ground support
questions.solution: As high as possible.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing certificate' in a mine certifies that
options: Stowing has been carried out as per the approved plan
The name of the stowing contractor
questions.solution: Stowing carried out as per approved plan.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stone dust barrier' in coal mines serves to
options: Arrest explosion propagation by releasing stone dust
questions.solution: Stone dust barriers arrest explosion propagation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A serious accident must be reported to the Chief Inspector within
questions.solution: Within 24 hours.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Every engine, motor, transformer and battery-charging room on the surface of a mine shall be provided with at least:
options: Two exits, properly maintained and kept free from obstruction
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 212: such rooms are kept clean and provided with at least two exits, properly maintained and free from obstruction.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'blast pattern' in mining includes
options: The weight of the explosive only
Hole arrangement, spacing, and delay sequence
questions.solution: Hole arrangement, spacing, and delay sequence.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The safety devices on a winding engine include
options: Governor, overspeed device, braking system, and depth indicator
questions.solution: Multiple safety devices are required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'shift report' should be written
options: At the end of each shift
questions.solution: At the end of each shift.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: For electrical machinery and plant, the competent person for inspection under CMR 2017 shall be an engineer or electrician holding qualifications specified in:
options: CEA (Measures relating to Safety and Electric Supply) Regulations, 2010
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 213(6): the competent person for electrical machinery holds qualifications as specified in the CEA Safety & Electric Supply Regulations, 2010.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'near miss report' is important because
options: It is only for the records
It helps identify potential hazards before actual accidents occur
questions.solution: Helps identify potential hazards before actual accidents occur.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rescue equipment inventory' must be
options: Kept with the coal stockyard records
questions.solution: Equipment inventory must be maintained and updated.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'working face' in mining is where
options: The actual extraction of coal or mineral takes place
The blasting of stone for building
questions.solution: Actual extraction takes place.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A rope shovel is used in
options: Large open cast mines for loading overburden and coal
questions.solution: Used in large open cast mines.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'delay detonator' in blasting is used to
options: Sequence the explosion of multiple holes for better fragmentation
questions.solution: Sequence explosions for better fragmentation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing environmental impact' includes
options: Water table changes, surface stability, and material sourcing
questions.solution: Environmental impact includes water table, surface stability, and sourcing.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A sirdar should not permit work to continue if
options: There is an accumulation of firedamp above the permissible limit
questions.solution: Work must not continue if firedamp exceeds permissible limits.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'disposal of mine waste' through stowing helps in
options: Reducing surface dumps and environmental impact
questions.solution: Reduces surface dumps and environmental impact.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'inundation hazard' in coal mines is increased by
options: Proximity to surface water bodies, old workings, and aquifers
questions.solution: Inundation hazard increases near water bodies, old workings, aquifers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'hand mining' or 'conventional mining' involves
questions.solution: Manual drilling, blasting, and loading.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'bord' in board and pillar mining refers to
options: The gallery driven along the dip
questions.solution: Bord is the gallery driven along the dip direction.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'notice of accident' under the Mines Act must be sent to
options: The inspector of mines and the Chief Inspector
questions.solution: To the inspector of mines and the Chief Inspector.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, a thorough inspection of all machinery and plant in use is required at least once in every:
options: 7 days, recorded in a bound paged book
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 213(5): a competent person thoroughly inspects all machinery and plant at least once in 7 days, recording results in a bound paged book.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'mine rescue plan' includes
options: The production schedule of the mine
Response procedures, team deployment, and communication
The leave roster of the workers
questions.solution: Rescue plans include procedures, deployment, communication.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'truck cycle time' includes
questions.solution: Truck cycle includes load, haul, dump, return.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: In a gassy seam of the second or third degree, no person shall supervise or operate electrical machinery unless he:
options: Holds a gas-testing certificate and carries an approved flame safety lamp
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 213(2): in 2nd/3rd-degree gassy seams, operators of electrical machinery (other than telephones/signals/lamps) hold a gas-testing certificate and carry an approved flame safety lamp.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'plan of the mine' must be kept by the manager at
options: At the residence of the manager
In the office at the mine and kept available for inspection
questions.solution: Regulation 64(6) of CMR 2017 requires all plans and sections to be kept available for inspection in the office at the mine.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'stopping' in mine ventilation is a permanent wall to
options: Provide fresh air to working faces
questions.solution: Blocks airflow completely.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fly ash' as stowing material has advantage of
options: Utilizing waste material and lighter weight
questions.solution: Fly ash utilizes waste and has lighter weight.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'digging height' of excavator determines
questions.solution: Digging height defines the vertical working range.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fire hose pipe' in a mine must be
options: Maintained in good condition and readily accessible
Painted and displayed in the showroom
questions.solution: Maintained in good condition and readily accessible.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'contractor workforce' in coal mines is managed through
questions.solution: Labor laws and safety regulations.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Man walks 5km/hr, misses train by 7min. Walks 6km/hr, reaches 5min early. Distance?
questions.solution: 6 km.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The capital of West Bengal is
questions.solution: Kolkata is the capital of West Bengal.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'CIL Singrauli Area' falls under which subsidiary?
questions.solution: CIL Singrauli Area falls under NCL.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: A man walks 3 km East, 4 km North. Distance from start?

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Which of the following is not a Union Territory?
questions.solution: Sikkim is a state, not a Union Territory.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: 'Excavate' is opposite of
questions.solution: Excavate means dig; fill is the opposite.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: A line graph shows production: Jan 100, Feb 120, Mar 110, Apr 130. What is the percentage increase from Jan to Apr?

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: A line graph shows employee count: 2020=1000, 2021=1050, 2022=1100, 2023=1200. What is the growth from 2020 to 2023?

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'District Mineral Foundation' (DMF) funds are used for
options: Payment of salaries to DGMS officers
Welfare of persons affected by mining
questions.solution: Welfare of persons affected by mining.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Boiling point of water at sea level is
questions.solution: Water boils at 100°C at sea level.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Fuel Supply Agreement' (FSA) is signed between
questions.solution: FSAs are signed between coal companies and power plants.

questions.subject: General
questions.solution: 14, 16, 18 are consecutive evens; 10 breaks pattern.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'DMF' (District Mineral Foundation) was established under
questions.solution: DMF was established under MMDR Act 2015.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: A train 200m long crosses a platform 300m long in 25 seconds. Speed in km/h?

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'coal sector nationalization' in India occurred in
questions.solution: Coal sector nationalization occurred in 1973.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Mine Closure Plan' is required under
questions.solution: Required under MMDR Act and CMR 2017.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Skill India Mission' aims to train
questions.solution: 400 million skilled workers by 2022.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The Chilika Lake is located in which Indian state?
questions.solution: Chilika Lake is in Odisha.
